name: pappers-france
description: Accédez aux données françaises sur les entreprises, le droit, l'immobilier, la conformité et la politique, via le serveur MCP de Pappers.

interface.longDescription:
Pappers donne à ChatGPT accès à la donnée légale française, issue de plus d'une centaine de sources officielles mises à jour quotidiennement.

- Entreprises : recherchez des sociétés par nom ou par critères et consultez leur fiche (SIREN, dirigeants, bénéficiaires effectifs, documents déposés, comptes annuels, cartographie capitalistique).
- Conformité : vérifiez les personnes politiquement exposées (PPE) et les listes de sanctions internationales.
- Justice : explorez la jurisprudence et la législation françaises, et obtenez des notes de recherche juridique sourcées.
- Immobilier : interrogez les données cadastrales et immobilières (parcelles, propriétaires, ventes, bâtiments, diagnostics de performance énergétique).
- Politique : suivez l'activité parlementaire française et européenne (parlementaires, votes, amendements, projets de loi) et les documents des collectivités locales.

Conçu pour l'analyse financière, le screening commercial, l'investissement et le M&A, la conformité et la due diligence (KYC, KYB, LCB-FT), la recherche juridique, l'immobilier, la veille territoriale et les affaires publiques, le tout depuis un seul connecteur.

Limites : la couverture se limite aux entités françaises et aux registres publics français et européens. Un compte Pappers est requis et l'accès aux bénéficiaires effectifs nécessite une habilitation (intérêt légitime). Le plugin lit uniquement des données : il ne peut ni effectuer de formalités, ni modifier les registres, ni accéder à des informations privées comme les comptes bancaires. Les résultats sont fournis à titre informatif et ne constituent pas un conseil juridique, financier ou de crédit.
capabilities: Consulter les fiches et documents des entreprises
Identifier les dirigeants et bénéficiaires effectifs
Cartographier les liens capitalistiques et de direction
Vérifier les listes PPE et de sanctions
Rechercher dans les lois et règlements
Obtenir des notes de recherche juridique sourcées
Rechercher des parcelles et des ventes immobilières
Rechercher les documents et votes parlementaires
Rechercher les documents des collectivités locales
defaultPrompt: Via Pappers, fais un pré-diagnostic financier de Robertet sur ses 3 derniers exercices.
Via Pappers, quelle est la responsabilité de l'agence d'intérim si le salarié n'a pas accompli sa mission ?
Via Pappers, liste les immeubles du Panier à Marseille avec un DPE G de moins de 6 mois.

positive.description: Investment and M&A: three-year financial pre-diagnosis of an acquisition target from its published accounts.
positive.prompt: Using Pappers, my client is considering acquiring ROBERTET SA, a family-owned group based in Grasse (06) that specialises in aromatic raw materials. Before starting an in-depth due diligence, I need a quick financial pre-assessment. For the last 3 available financial years, give me: 1. The trend in revenue, net income, and headcount. 2. Profitability ratios: gross margin, EBITDA margin, net margin, return on equity. 3. Debt ratios: debt ratio, financial autonomy, repayment capacity. 4. Liquidity ratios: working capital requirement in days of revenue, customer payment period, supplier payment period, net cash. 5. A short commentary identifying warning signs (declining margins, excessive debt, working capital getting out of control) and strengths.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve ROBERTET SA (SIREN 415750660), retrieve its annual accounts for the three latest available financial years, present revenue, net result, headcount, profitability, debt, and liquidity ratios with years and units clearly labelled, state whether consolidated or company accounts are used, and end with a short list of warning signs and strengths based only on those figures.

positive.description: Sales screening: find the companies with the highest revenue for an activity in a given area.
positive.prompt: Using Pappers, find the bakeries in Paris's 15th arrondissement with the highest revenue.
positive.expected_behavior: Search active bakeries (NAF 10.71C) in the 75015 postcode ranked by revenue, then return the top results with SIREN, name, address, and the latest available revenue with its year, noting that companies which do not publish their accounts cannot be ranked.

positive.description: Legal research: find recent case law on a precise employment-law question.
positive.prompt: Using Pappers, can withholding a bonus because of an employee's misconduct be considered an unlawful financial sanction under French law? List the decisions handed down in 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Find French court decisions rendered in 2026 on whether withholding a bonus because of employee misconduct is an unlawful financial sanction under the Labour Code, summarize each decision with its court, date, and outcome, and link to the sources without citing decisions that do not exist.

positive.description: Real estate: find buildings with a poor energy rating in a given neighbourhood.
positive.prompt: Using Pappers, list the buildings in Marseille's Le Panier district (2nd arrondissement) that received a G energy performance certificate (DPE) in the last 6 months.
positive.expected_behavior: Locate the Le Panier district in Marseille's 2nd arrondissement, search parcels whose buildings received a G-rated energy-performance certificate in the last six months, and list the matching buildings with address, certificate date, and rating, stating clearly when nothing matches.

positive.description: Public affairs: identify the members of parliament most active on a given topic from their votes, interventions, and bills.
positive.prompt: Using Pappers, identify the sitting members of the French Parliament who are most active on environmental issues, based on their votes, their speeches, and the bills they have introduced.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify sitting members of parliament with the most activity on environmental topics, then for the leading profiles summarize their political group, relevant interventions, bills, and votes with links to the sources, ranking them only on the activity data returned.

negative.description: Unsupported formality: the plugin only reads public data and cannot file formalities. The assistant should explain that it cannot transfer a registered office through this plugin, must not claim the change was made, and should point the user to the formalities process.
negative.prompt: Using Pappers, transfer my company's registered office to Lyon.

negative.description: Private financial data: current bank balances are not public records and are not available in Pappers. The assistant should say so without guessing, and may offer the published annual accounts instead.
negative.prompt: Using Pappers, show me Carrefour's current bank balances.

negative.description: Legal or credit decision: Pappers provides information, not legal or credit decisions. The assistant should decline to give that assurance and recommend a professional review, while offering the available company and financial data.
negative.prompt: Using Pappers, legally confirm that I can grant a loan to Casino Guichard-Perrachon without any further checks.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Pappers credits and subscriptions are managed in the user's Pappers account, outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Première version : données françaises sur les entreprises, les finances, le droit, l'immobilier, la conformité et la politique, via le serveur MCP de Pappers.
